card.name: Day counts and day numbers
card.fires_on: Words and numbers in day-based schedules: the word day or days, or the number right after it (days 1 to 21, day 1 only), and a few words right after day.

modes.label: Day number after Days
modes.description: A digit that follows the word day or days in a dosing cycle or schedule.

modes.label: The word day itself
modes.description: The word day or days when it marks which day to start or stop something.
modes.example: The woman may switch from the POP on any<< day>>; instruct her to start using Eton

modes.label: Word right after day
modes.description: A linking word that comes just after day in a general statement about a day.
